'''Alejandro Saab''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Saab was born on November 15, 1994, in Dallas, Texas. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of Western cartoons. Saab joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where he voiced recurring character {{an|Leon}}. He is also a well known YouTube Personality and [[Twitch]] Streamer.
